What I can do for you.

Nine things I do well, with a real example of each, a starting price and the deposit that starts the work. Every engagement begins the same way: a brief, a booked meeting, a price in writing.

01Service

Web platforms and apps

A learning platform, a client portal, a marketplace or a landing page, designed, built, bilingual if you need it, and live with payments.

Example: Uplink IT Academy: seven rooms, exam sets, a ticket simulator and labs, with Stripe payments and a daily content pipeline.

  • Scope and sitemap in writing
  • Design system and mobile first screens
  • Build with database, auth and payments
  • Launch on your domain, with documentation
from $4,500per platform; landing pages from 1,500
02Service

Build with AI, coached

I show founders and teams how to design, build and ship real products with AI assistants, from the brief to the deploy, without the hype.

Example: The method used on every platform on this site, taught live on your own project.

  • Your project set up and shipped during the session
  • A written playbook of the method
  • Prompts and checklists you keep
  • Follow up by email for a week
from $120per hour; half day workshop 600
03Service

Network design, deployment and documentation

I design and deploy whole site networks: WiFi coverage, switching, cameras, door access, rack and cabling, drawn on your floor plans, installed, then documented in a book an installer can work from.

Example: Site networks deployed for offices and venues, and the ten page project book: coverage maps, rack elevation, bill of materials with prices, timeline and acceptance.

  • Site survey and floor plan review
  • Design drawings and coverage maps
  • Bill of materials with list prices
  • Installation, configuration and handover
  • Printable project book, PDF
from $5,000per site deployment; design and documentation alone from 500

  • A self-check for every lab

from $900per module

How it worksFive steps

Brief. Book. Reserve. Meet. Build.

1

Tell me what you want

Fill the brief below: the goal, the audience, what exists today, references you like, budget range and deadline. Be concrete; it saves us both a meeting.

2

Pick a time

Choose three slots that suit you and the platform you prefer: Zoom, Microsoft Teams or Google Meet. I confirm one by email within a day.

3

Reserve the consultation

A 45 minute consultation is 150 dollars, paid by card. It is credited to your project if you book within thirty days.

4

We meet online

We go through the brief, I ask the questions that matter, and you leave with a scope, a price and a timeline in writing.

5

Deposit, build, deliver

A deposit starts the work. You review at each milestone. Delivery includes two rounds of revisions and documentation.
